pre_run_hypotheses: All 24 populated authored tables import/export exactly, native conversion has zero errors, and output/report are valid.

The group profile orders six one-aircraft missions in three pairs. For each pair, native selection should identify both explicit physical member units, one aircraft per base, rather than conflating group and member identities.

Events should permit separate BASE-01 and BASE-02 aircraft, item, stock, transport, repair and backorder ledgers through the horizon; every native System and Stock report interval should reconcile to those events.
Changed ownership or group search can change timing and random draws; exact event parity with the parent is an observation, not a presumption.
decision_rule: Accept a bounded unit-group expansion case only if the frozen source converts, both physical member units provide distinct aircraft to each scheduled pair or equivalent fully traceable group orders, independent per-base ledgers and numeric report bins reconcile, and a separate independent read-only replay passes. Otherwise seal a diagnostic without claiming group expansion acceptance.
limits: One seed, two equal-priority explicit members, one aircraft per member, and three scheduled paired waves; no priority, XTIME or stochastic fairness law.
No implicit group member discovery, GUI visual or cross-engine claim.
